data.name: Imtinan
data.gender_notes: Imtinan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imtinan is a name that symbolizes trustworthiness and loyalty. It is derived from the Arabic word 'amana', meaning to trust or to entrust. In Islamic tradition, trustworthiness is considered one of the most important virtues. The name Imtinan carries the meaning “Trustworthiness, loyalty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imtinan usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthiness, loyalty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person with the name Imtinan is expected to be trustworthy and loyal, with a strong sense of responsibility and commitment.
data.etymology: Imtinan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthiness, loyalty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imtinan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
